headline: Dish TV announces resignation of Chief Customer Experience Officer Swami Mehra
hook: Customer experience head steps down at Dish TV
summary: Dish TV India Limited has announced that Mr Swami Mehra, the company's Chief Customer Experience Officer, is stepping down effective October 30, 2026. The exchange filing details the departure of the senior executive from the television distribution company. Retail investors should note that senior management exits in media and direct-to-home firms can reflect ongoing operational transitions or strategic realignments. Routine executive changes of this scale generally have a minimal direct impact on immediate share price movement.
why_it_matters: Routine management exit with minimal direct impact on stock price.

headline: Nine penny stocks plunge up to 57 percent in two months
summary: Nine low-priced shares have recorded sharp declines of up to 57 percent over a two-month period. Such steep corrections in micro-cap counters highlight the high volatility and severe downside risks associated with speculative low-value equities. Retail investors dealing in penny stocks face sudden capital erosion due to low liquidity and sudden sentiment shifts. Understanding these risks helps retail participants avoid overexposure to highly volatile small-cap counters.
why_it_matters: Speculative small-cap holdings face severe sudden downside risks.
